wiki.title: Mike Porfirio
wiki.extract: Mike Porfirio is an American politician. He serves as a Democratic member for the 11th district of the Illinois Senate. The 11th district includes all or parts of Bedford Park, Berwyn, Bridgeview, Brookfield, Burbank, Cicero, Countryside, Hodgkins, Justice, La Grange, La Grange Park, North Riverside, Riverside, Summit and the Chicago neighborhoods of Ashburn, Clearing, Chicago, Garfield Ridge, West Elsdon, and West Lawn.
